mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This is paired with the recorded rule that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions, so no host is carved out of either requirement.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, and that HTTPS is used everywhere with no exceptions.

This comes from two recorded decisions: #22, "verification on all builds", and the newer #25, "https everywhere, no exceptions". #22 replaced an earlier decision that let development builds skip verification. I left that earlier decision out, as you asked.

An earlier session also recorded "plain http for internal hosts". That is only a transcript excerpt, not a recorded decision, and #25 is newer and contradicts it. I didn't use it.
